At Husky TechnologiesTM, we strive to be the best with a strong foundation built on innovation, collaboration and a unique culture with great people. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! What We Offer Excellent benefits package and retirement savings plans as well as life insurance program Competitive vacation policy promoting work-life balance Challenging career opportunities and growth Opportunity to work, innovate and collaborate with passionate people who drive change Amazing team – we are the best in the world at what we do! Husky TechnologiesTM Campus Large, beautiful campus with clean, state-of-the-art air-conditioned offices and manufacturing facilities with high air quality, climate control and outstanding safety records Onsite fitness and wellness center Organized out- and indoor sports activities such as running teams, and bicycle teams Access to onsite medical practitioners Onsite cafeterias with fresh and healthy meal options Free parking Job Description The Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness. R eporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth. Responsibilities: Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints. Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events. Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity. Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions. Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives. Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership. Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities. Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives. Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis. Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement. Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools. Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging. Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business. Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness. Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution. Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability. Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity. Leadership & Experience The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement. Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable. The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset. 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment. Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets. Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives. Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

review_candidates.description: Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics , one of Danaher’s operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where your perspective matters, and by applying the Danaher Business System (DBS) , you will help turn strategy into sustained results. As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Country Manager, Puerto Rico serves as the most senior Beckman Coulter leader and legal representative in Puerto Rico, with full accountability for enterprise strategy, commercial performance, organizational leadership, and external representation. This role holds end‑to‑end accountability for shaping and executing the country’s strategic direction, including evolving the go‑to‑market model and advancing sustainable growth, margin performance, and long‑term customer partnerships. The breadth of scope, depth of decision‑making authority, and level of internal and external influence required are consistent with an M3 leadership role. This position reports to the Latin America Vice President and is part of Commercial area located in Puerto Rico and will be an on-site role. This position is part of the Latin America Organization, willing to travel 50 % of the time serving time serving Caribbean countries. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time. In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To Act as the highest‑level authority and legal representative for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics in Puerto Rico, accountable for governance, compliance, and corporate reputation. Own and approve strategic commercial decisions including pricing, quotations, RFPs, and long‑term contractual agreements with hospitals, distributors, and reference laboratories. Define and execute the country strategy, including evolving the go‑to‑market approach and channel model to deliver sustainable growth and value creation. Build and lead a multi‑year strategic business plan aligned with Danaher growth priorities and long‑term market leadership objectives. Serve as the central leadership axis for Puerto Rico, providing transversal leadership across commercial, service, finance, operations, and support functions within a matrix environment. Represent Beckman Coulter with government agencies, industry associations, health systems, and key opinion leaders, strengthening innovation leadership and market position. Lead, coach, and develop senior leaders, ensuring attraction, retention, and engagement of high‑impact leadership talent critical to long‑term business success. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred (Business, Healthcare, or Life Sciences) and 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in medical devices, diagnostics, or healthcare Proven experience leading complex, regulated markets with significant stakeholder influence Demonstrated success in business turnarounds, restructuring go‑to‑market models, or restoring growth Strong financial, commercial, and contractual acumen (pricing, margin, RFPs, long‑term agreements) Executive‑level influencing skills within matrix organizations Fluency in Spanish and English Ability to operate credibly at C‑suite, government, and institutional levels Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements Available for travelling >50% of worktime, be on site with customers. Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in: Fluent understanding of hospital and laboratories operating financials and healthcare economics Strong communication and presentation skills; demonstrated ability to clearly, concisely, and accurately conduct executive level presentations Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com. review_candidates.title: Chief Accountant
review_candidates.description: Job Location: Avani Victoria Falls Resort Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people. Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits. The Chief Accountant is responsible for ensuring that all the financial affairs of the hotel are conducted to the highest standards of honesty and integrity. High ethical standards are necessary to maintain both competitive advantage and the pride and confidence of our associates and to provide quality products and services to customers and clients. To ensure that the financial statement is closed and audited in a timely manner and accurate Key Responsibilities Financial Reporting and Analysis Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, operating information, and reports. Provide analysis, interpretations, and projections for all business units. Regularly monitor and analyse the hotel’s cash inflows and outflows to ensure sufficient liquidity for meeting obligations. Ensure proper financial controls and transparency in financial reporting. Maintain the safekeeping of contracts, leases, and other financial records. Strategic Financial Planning and Management Provide financial input into the formulation and implementation of strategic plans, budgets, forecasts, and capital investments. Evaluate returns on major investments and identify opportunities for process improvements. Support strategic decision-making with financial insights and recommendations. Support DOF/FC in initiating improvement for revenue, profitability and cost-saving Monthly and Periodic Financial Tasks Preparing and/or reviewing daily, weekly and monthly reports in accordance with the reporting calendars and Finance Policy Manual and ensuring that all reports are submitted on a timely basis and accurate. Finalize P&L and ensure necessary journal entries are created for corrections. Verify and upload financial reports and ensure accuracy and timeliness. Coordination and Collaboration Collaborate with external parties including auditors, asset appraisers, accountants or consultants. Accommodate internal, external, or statutory audit requests as directed by the DOF/FC. Critique P&L results with the GM, Director of Finance, and department heads, resolving variances and implementing corrective actions Ensure plans and actions are documented and followed up for any weaknesses identified during Internal Audits or Finance Operation Compliance reviews. Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Banking Manage accounts payable functions, ensuring timely processing and compliance. Review and approve payments, ensuring accuracy and adherence to contract terms. Monitor accounts receivable and billing processes, overseeing collections efforts. Handle banking transactions, including cash management and local tax deposits. Conduct credit meetings with the DOF/FC, credit manager, and other participants. Ensure maximum efforts for debt collection. Team Leadership and Development Recruit, evaluate, and motivate accounting department staff. Provide leadership and coordinate daily activities within the finance team. Identify training needs and support professional development initiatives. Foster a productive and collaborative work environment to maximize team performance. Reduce staff turnover and ensure that all sections of the department are functioning properly and efficiently. Record Keeping and Documentation Maintain organized and accurate financial records. Document financial policies, procedures, and internal controls. Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations Minimum Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related field. Full professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CIMA, ZICA, or equivalent. Minimum of 5 years' accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a senior finance role. Hospitality industry experience will be a distinct advantage. Strong knowledge of financial reporting standards and statutory compliance requirements. Proficiency in accounting and ERP systems. Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial analysis skills. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational abilities. High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail. Competencies Strategic and analytical thinking. Financial planning and budgeting. Problem-solving and decision-making. Strong business acumen. Team leadership and people development. Effective stakeholder management. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

review_candidates.description: Organisation NAVAL GROUP Acteur international du naval de défense, Naval Group est partenaire des États dans la maîtrise de leur souveraineté maritime. Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires Description Du Poste Le site de Saint-Tropez accueille des activités d’étude, de conception, de construction et de maintenance de systèmes d’armes sous-marines et des systèmes associés : torpilles, contre-mesures et drones sous-marins. Le poste, a horizon fin 2027/début 2028, sera sur notre futur site à La Londe les Maures. Naval Group recrute, pour son site de Saint-Tropez un/une ingénieur systèmes embarqués en charge de réaliser les études complexes, contribuer à la justification des choix et compromis relatifs au cahier des charge, proposer et participer à la réalisation des études dans les domaines électronique et mécanique.
